dedupeText: retro psychedelic portrait layout 1960s aesthetic psychedelic typography sepia portrait tracklist layout vintage fashion warm vignette subject s direct gaze creates a central focal point against a muted background warped heavy weight title contrasts with the rigid small scale tracklist warm earthy tones in the clothing and background harmonize with the sepia skin tones combine a centered vintage studio portrait with a top right liquid warped display title and a bottom left dense sans serif list all unified by a warm sepia color grade and heavy vignette

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with long dark hair, framed by a warm, sepia-toned vignette. The composition features a large, warped psychedelic title in the upper right and a dense, left-aligned sans-serif tracklist in the lower left, creating a diagonal tension across the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's direct gaze creates a central focal point against a muted background.
Warped, heavy-weight title contrasts with the rigid, small-scale tracklist.
Warm, earthy tones in the clothing and background harmonize with the sepia skin tones.
coreInvariants: Soft-focus studio lighting with minimal harsh shadows.
Warm, desaturated color palette favoring ochre, brown, and muted red.
Heavy vignetting that darkens the corners and edges.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up-right to the bold title, then down-left to the tracklist text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the head, filled with a textured, gradient-like sepia wash.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and muted tan (background and skin tones).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and black (hair and small text).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and pink (title lettering and clothing accents).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the dark hair/text.

letterConstructionRules: Overlapping glyphs with thick black outlines
Bulbous terminals and fluid, organic curves
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are squeezed and stretched to fit a curved, arc-like container in the top right corner.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the subject's shoulder and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between organic, warped display type and rigid, functional sans-serif metadata.

preserve: The liquid, melting quality of the top-right text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary functional contrast for the tracklist

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with long straight dark hair, wearing a high-collared patterned vintage dress in ochre and red. The lighting is warm and diffused. The background is a textured sepia gradient with a heavy dark vignette around the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line title in the top right corner using ultra-bold psychedelic lettering with a heavy black outline, warped into an arc. Add a multi-line, left-aligned list of text in a small, bold sans-serif font in the lower left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the title text warped and outlined?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones?
Is the tracklist text small and left-aligned?
Does the portrait have a soft-focus, vintage film quality?

adjustableVariables: Degree of warp on the display typography
Pattern complexity on the subject's clothing
mustRedesign: Specific track names and artist names
Specific facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized display type
avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the vignette is dark enough to frame the subject.
Check that the display type has a thick black outline.
Confirm the overall tone is warm and sepia-based.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered vintage studio portrait with a top-right liquid-warped display title and a bottom-left dense sans-serif list, all unified by a warm sepia color grade and heavy vignette.
